name: OTEL Trace Visualization
description: User interaction flow for selecting and viewing trace details in the dev workspace

scenarios.description: User selected trace from SystemMonitor and trace details were rendered in DevWorkspace

template.introduction:
**Trace Visualization Complete**

User selected trace `{{trace.id}}` from SystemMonitor.

DevWorkspace opened TraceDetailsPanel showing **{{spans.count}} spans** in {{render.duration_ms}}ms.

events.otel.collector.trace_received: [3] Collector parsed trace in {{collector.mode}} mode ({{resource.spans.count}} resource spans, format: {{trace.format}})

template.summary:
**Trace Details:**
- Trace ID: `{{trace.id}}`
- Tab: {{tab.label}}
- Spans: {{spans.count}}
- Services: {{services.count}}

**Visualization Flow:**
```
1. SystemMonitor polls traces every 2s
2. User clicks trace in list
3. Panel event bus emits trace:selected
4. DevWorkspace catches event
5. Creates new tab: trace-{{trace.id}}
6. TraceDetailsPanel renders with full OTLP data
7. User sees span hierarchy, timing, attributes
```

**Performance:**
- Traces Fetched: {{traces.fetched}}
- Poll Interval: {{poll.interval_ms}}ms
- Render Time: {{render.duration_ms}}ms

**Panel Features:**
- Span hierarchy (parent-child relationships)
- Timing waterfall visualization
- Span attributes display
- Resource attributes
- Status codes and messages

**Event Flow:**
SystemMonitor -> EventBus -> DevWorkspace -> TraceDetailsPanel

scenarios.description: SystemMonitor is polling and displaying traces but user hasn't selected any yet

**Traces Available in SystemMonitor**

SystemMonitor is polling the collector and displaying {{traces.fetched}} traces from {{services.count}} services.

Traces are ready for user selection and visualization.

template.summary:
**SystemMonitor Status:**
- Polling: Active
- Interval: {{poll.interval_ms}}ms (2 seconds)
- Traces Fetched: {{traces.fetched}}
- Limit: {{traces.limit}}
- Services: {{services.count}}

**Storage:**
- Current Size: {{storage.size}}/{{storage.max_size}}
- Format: Circular buffer
- Retention: Last 50 traces

**Data Flow:**
```
Collector Storage (50 traces max)
        | [every 2s]
IPC Handler: getTraces(20)
        |
SystemMonitor TraceViewer
        |
Groups by service name
        |
Converts to AgentPrism format
        |
Displays in collapsible sections
```

**Service Grouping:**
Traces are automatically grouped by `service.name` attribute from resource attributes.

**Available Actions:**
- Click trace to open in DevWorkspace
- Clear all traces button
- Send test trace button
- View collector status

**What's Next:**
User can click any trace to visualize detailed span hierarchy in DevWorkspace.
